completed_work: Fixed BFS depth propagation into node upserts: hop plans now carry rowDepth, so the root node is depth 0 instead of null and fetched nodes keep their queue depth.
Verified redirect chains create one endpoint node per hop with its own 3xx status and a link edge between consecutive hops.
Verified robots.txt blocks /secret by default and --ignore-robots fetches it.
Verified response bodies are stored once under bodies/<xx>/<sha256> with a bodies row and title/text metadata.
Verified flag{demo} produces a findings row and an aggregated artifact node, and root degree is populated by the edge trigger.
Verified resume of an already-completed scan performs no fetches and inserts zero new nodes/edges.
notes: The only implementation defect found in the crawl engine was the missing depth field on hop upserts; the rest of the stage-3 behavior was already present and is now covered by passing integration tests.
